assumptions.statement: Repository provisional site and key-area polygons are used only for generation, visualization and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: Replace all boundary-dependent layers, metrics, figures and reports when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal, fire and heritage constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control, demolition, engineering feasibility or implementation conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual building footprints are not a survey of existing buildings.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish decisions require field survey, rights review and structural assessment.

assumptions.statement: Events, governance and operating entities are reference mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: No funding, procurement, investment or government commitment is implied.
